# Lumora Bio (biotech startup) · external concept

Live: https://lumora-bio.vercel.app (separate project, not in this repo)

## Layout fingerprint
- hero: light, centered headline with an abstract molecular/cell SVG, two buttons
- nav: sticky light header, anchor links (About, Science, Team, Contact)
- sections: small eyebrow label + heading, centered or left, lots of white space
- grid: centered container; 3-card rows (science/pipeline), 4–6 team cards, logo row
- background: white / very light neutral throughout
- signature: pipeline stages (Discovery → Validation → Clinical); initials team avatars
- palette: light neutrals with a single cool scientific accent
- type: clean sans-serif, minimal
